name: filingbridge
description: Prepare Irish statutory accounts, CRO filing outputs and Revenue CT1 support in FilingBridge, as the person who connected it.
long_description:
The FilingBridge connector calls FilingBridge's own API as you, within your role and company assignments, at the access level and data scope you chose when you signed in. Every limit is enforced by FilingBridge, not by this extension. Removals and irreversible or privileged steps stop and wait for you to approve them in your own terminal or on the web approvals page. CRO and ROS final submission remain external actions recorded in workflow state.

This extension never asks for your password. Before first use, sign in once in a terminal with the same profile and address you enter here, for example: node dist/cli.js connect --profile private --base-url http://127.0.0.1:3500 --tenant-slug <workspace> --email you@example.ie (run from the extension's folder or a checkout of the connector). The session is kept in your operating system's credential store.

Created by Jasper Ford; contributor hOUR Timebank CLG (Ireland). Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later.

base_url.title: FilingBridge address
base_url.description: The address you open FilingBridge at, with no path: http://127.0.0.1:3500 for a Private Server on this computer, https://<host>.<tailnet>.ts.net through Tailscale Serve, or your https address for a public installation. Use exactly the address you gave connect.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which kind of FilingBridge the address may be: private (a Private Server on this computer or a Tailscale *.ts.net name), default (any https address) or local (a Development stack on this computer). The connector refuses an address its profile does not allow.

download_dir.title: Folder downloads are written into
download_dir.description: Leave this empty and downloads (accounts PDFs, filing packs, iXBRL, CT1 worksheet) are not offered at all. Files are written here and never returned to the assistant; only the path and checksum are.

upload_root.title: Folder files may be uploaded from
upload_root.description: Leave this empty and the bank CSV import and evidence attachments are not offered at all. Nothing outside this folder can be read, however a path is spelled.
